description: This file defines the high-level API for the Mirror module of the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch. It includes enumeration definitions and declarations for functions related to port mirroring, port isolation, VLAN leaky settings, and override controls in the switch device.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_set
methods.description: Sets the port mirror function by specifying the monitoring port and the mirror port masks for RX and TX.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current port mirror configuration, including monitor port and port masks for RX and TX.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_set
methods.description: Enables or disables mirror port isolation, preventing normal forwarding packets to the mirror port.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_get
methods.description: Gets the current mirror port isolation status.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_set
methods.description: Configures VLAN leaky settings for mirror VLAN traffic, enabling or disabling TX and RX leaky modes.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current VLAN leaky settings for mirror VLAN traffic.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_set
methods.description: Sets the leaky mode for mirror port isolation.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_get
methods.description: Gets the current leaky mode status for mirror port isolation.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_set
methods.description: Sets the mirror packet format keep mode, determining how packet format is retained in mirror traffic.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current mirror packet format keep mode.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_override_set
methods.description: Configures the override behavior for port mirroring, controlling how normal and mirrored packets are output.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_override_get
methods.description: Gets the current mirror override settings for RX, TX, and ACL mirroring.
